summary: Today 58 baseline trades settled: 32 wins, net P&L -306.42, return -0.53%. The facts hold no rule or AI family results and no pick-rule results, so no rule-vs-AI comparison can be made. Across the items, wins came from sector lift (WMT, XOM) or a company-specific move (DE); the misses came from sector and market drag (UAL), company-specific weakness (CAT) and negative news (BAC). All ten items ran in an EVENT_HEAVY regime. Several exits finished outside the 80% range: DE and XOM above its high, UAL and CAT below its low.
